# A backfill of 12 days in chunks of 5. Day 4 has no tickets, day 6 has two pages, day 9 is not closed yet and day 11 fails at the source.
# The loaded days are in the warehouse once each. A second backfill of the same range does only the two days that are left, and a third does nothing.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

pipeinit
pipefakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env PIPE_DIR=$WORK/pl
env PIPE_HOME=$WORK/pipe
replace pl/version.star 'CHUNK = 100' 'CHUNK = 5'

exec beehavereal item add pipeline bf-1 --title 'January' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run bf-1 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star
stdout 'item bf-1 finished'

# The run of the backfill records steps for the 3 chunks and none for a day: its history does not grow with the days of a chunk, and a child run holds the days.
cp stderr bf1.err
grep -count=3 'item-bf-1-r1 step item_create:chunk-r[0-9]-[0-9] done' bf1.err
! grep 'item-bf-1-r1 step [^ ]*2026-' bf1.err

# Nine days were labeled, each once, and the empty day was loaded without a call of the agent.
grep -count=9 '^classify ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-01-06$' calls.log
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^10$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT rows FROM manifest WHERE day = "2026-01-04"'
stdout '^0$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT rows FROM manifest WHERE day = "2026-01-06"'
stdout '^5$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labeled'
stdout '^29$'
# The extract of day 6 read two pages.
grep -count=2 'day=2026-01-06' curl.log

# The source closes day 9 and day 11 answers again. A second backfill of the range does only those two days.
rm src/open-2026-01-09
rm src/fail-2026-01-11
exec beehavereal item add pipeline bf-2 --title 'January again' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run bf-2 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star
stdout 'item bf-2 finished'
grep -count=11 '^classify ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^classify 2026-01-01$' calls.log
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manifest'
stdout '^12$'
exec sqlite3 pipe/warehouse.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labeled'
stdout '^35$'

# A third backfill finds nothing to do.
exec beehavereal item add pipeline bf-3 --title 'January a third time' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run bf-3 pipeline --workflow pl/backfill.star
stdout 'item bf-3 finished'
grep -count=11 '^classify ' calls.log

-- body.txt --
2026-01-01 2026-01-12
-- src/n-2026-01-04 --
0
-- src/n-2026-01-06 --
5
-- src/open-2026-01-09 --
-- src/fail-2026-01-11 --
-- pipe/config --
SOURCE_API=http://source.test
-- pipe/credential.header --
X-Token: TESTONLY
